name: Transition to Uni (TU) Pathway Scholarship (SCU)
summary: $2,500 offered with an Early Offer to SCU's Transition to Uni summer pathway in 2027, paid as you move into a bachelor degree.
key: Each scholarship is worth a total of $2,500.
who: Starting the Transition to Uni program in 2027 with an Early Offer.
Completing it in Summer 2027 and moving straight into the packaged bachelor degree.
how: No application required. It comes with the course offer.
catches: 40 places, given to the first 40 students who accept, with a waiting list.
Paid in instalments: $1,000 after the summer census, $500 when the degree starts, $1,000 after the first two subjects.
